member.summary: Parses the response data from a GET STATUS command to extract application information.

member.returns: An immutable list of ApplicationInfo objects representing the applications found on the card. Returns an empty list if no applications are found or if the response data is invalid.

remarks.para: This method implements parsing of GlobalPlatform GET STATUS response format per Card Specification v2.3.1:

item.description: Entry Format: Each application entry starts with tag E3 followed by length and data
TLV Structure: Within each entry, TLV elements provide AID, lifecycle state, and privileges
Two-byte Tags: Special handling for 9F70 (lifecycle state) tag

remarks.para: Application types are determined based on privileges and lifecycle state: Security Domains have privilege 0x80, Executable Load Files have lifecycle bit 0x01.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Services.GlobalPlatformService.ParseApplicationEntry(System.Byte[])
member.summary: Parses a single application entry from GET STATUS response data.
member.param: The TLV data for a single application entry (content of an E3 tag).
member.returns: An ApplicationInfo object if parsing succeeds, or null if the entry data is invalid or incomplete.

remarks.para: This method handles the detailed parsing of application entry TLV structure:

item.description: AID Extraction: Looks for 4F or 84 tags containing the application AID
Lifecycle Parsing: Handles both single-byte and 9F70 two-byte lifecycle tags
Privilege Parsing: Converts privilege byte to individual privilege flags
Type Detection: Determines application type based on privileges and state

remarks.para: The method is designed to be robust against malformed data. If any critical information (like AID) is missing, it returns null rather than throwing exceptions. This ensures that partial parsing failures don't prevent processing of other entries.
